verdict.rationale: An interactive API reference is a fair question for an agent product like dots, but the evidence shows none. All OpenAPI/Swagger probe paths returned 404, and the runtime probe found no dots-specific public API, CLI, or MCP-server surface. The llms.txt index and .md doc mirrors are agent-readable docs, not an interactive API reference with runnable examples, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
